metaTitle: Pricing for player, parent and manager — P.L.A.W
metaDescription: What it costs to follow one player in P.L.A.W: the practice list and every detail are visible without a subscription, the calendar and the analytics come with it.
title: One player, one price.
subtitle: You follow the practices of the player the coach's code connected you to. The list of practices and every detail stay visible without a subscription — the subscription adds the calendar and the analytics.
yearlyNote: Paying for the year costs almost half of paying monthly.
trialNote: 14 days to try it out, then it's paid.
compareSubtitle: Without a subscription you still get the answer to “what did my child practise”. What you pay for is the convenience, the overview and a longer history.
compareRows: Practice list with a month filter
Analytics — breakdowns, percentages, comparison over time
notes: Records keep arriving even when you're not subscribed — nothing is deleted, and a subscription makes them visible again.
One subscription covers one player. Following two children needs two accounts for now.
You need a connect code from the coach — without it there is nothing to follow.
The first 14 days are a trial; after that it's paid — same as for coaches.
ctaTitle: Got a code from your coach?
ctaText: Log in or create an account and start following the practices.
